input.requirements: Every acknowledged append must be present after the writer process exits abruptly. Scope: One SQLite database on a local filesystem, DELETE journal, synchronous=FULL; abrupt writer-process exit only. input.requirements: Queue size must stay at or below two, and every accepted message must remain queued until a consumer processes it. A full queue may reject an arrival before accepting it. Scope: Three immediate arrivals into an in-memory queue of capacity two, with no consumer running during the burst; accepted-message preservation before processing only.
